about.page_subtitle: Engineering student, apprentice at NOVARES, currently on international internship in Timișoara. Here's how I think, and how I work.
about.bio: Apprentice engineer at NOVARES and student at INSA Hauts-de-France, I design and simulate complex mechanical systems. My approach combines analytical rigor and mastery of advanced digital tools: from classical FEA to industrial virtual reality environments.
about.bio_2: Currently on an international internship in Timișoara, Romania, I apply these skills to real industrial challenges in a demanding, multicultural environment.

expertise.page_subtitle: A methodical toolkit, built around numerical simulation, 3D design and industrial virtual reality.

experience.page_subtitle: Four years building structure: industrial apprenticeship, simulation projects, VR environments and international internship.

timisoara.description: End-of-4th-year industrial internship. Immersion in an international industrial environment, applying simulation and analysis methods to real-world problems in a multicultural context.

novares.description: Mechanical engineering apprenticeship at a global Tier-1 automotive supplier. Material characterization, numerical simulation development and creation of reproducible industrial workflows.

vr_tech.description: Design and deployment of immersive VR environments for industrial training and ergonomic validation. CAD assembly import, physical interactions and haptic feedback integration.

insa.description: General engineering degree with specialization in mechanics, thermics and industrial systems. Multidisciplinary projects, laboratory practical work and industrial case studies.

projects.page_subtitle: Concrete case studies: FEA simulations, industrial VR environments and material characterization. Each project, a measurable outcome.

items.title: FEA Analysis on Automotive Part
items.subtitle: Mechanical stress simulation
items.description: Finite element modeling and simulation of an automotive plastic component under dynamic loads. Geometry optimization based on simulation results to reduce mass while maintaining resistance criteria.

items.title: Industrial VR Environment
items.subtitle: Workstation simulation
items.description: Development of an immersive virtual reality environment for ergonomic training and validation of an industrial workstation. CAD assembly import, physical interactions and haptic feedback.

items.title: Material Characterization
items.subtitle: Rheological and mechanical analysis
items.description: Mechanical characterization program for technical polymers used in the automotive industry. Tensile testing, rheological analysis and behavioral modeling to feed simulation databases.
